title: What a cell's RNA is made of
subtitle: Approximate share of total RNA mass in a typical mammalian cell (textbook ranges).

items.label: Ribosomal RNA (rRNA)
items.detail: Roughly 80–85%. The ribosome's structural and catalytic core.

items.label: Transfer RNA (tRNA)
items.detail: Roughly 10–15%. Small adaptors, densely chemically modified.

items.label: Messenger RNA (mRNA)
items.detail: Roughly 3–5%. The protein-coding message, and the main subject of this page.

items.label: Other small and long ncRNAs
items.detail: snRNAs, snoRNAs, microRNAs, lncRNAs and more. Small by mass, large in variety.
